subheader: Anyị na-anabata ajụjọ sitere n'aka ndị erite uru, ndị ọrụ afọ ofufo, ndị nyere onyinye, ndị mmekọ, ndị nnọchi anya mgbasa ozi na ọha na eze.
description: Ndị otu anyị dị njikere inyere gị aka n'ajụjọ gbasara mmemme anyị, ohere mmekọrịta, itinye aka n'ọrụ afọ ofufo ma ọ bụ ụzọ ịkwado ozi anyị.
formDescription: Dejupụta fọm dị n'okpuru wee otu onye otu anyị zaa ozugbo enwere ike.
subject: Isiokwu
subjectPlaceholder: ọmụmaatụ: Ajụjụ ọrụ afọ ofufo, Ajụjụ onyinye, Mmasị mmekọrịta
messagePlaceholder: Biko nye nkọwa ka anyị wee nwee ike inyere gị aka nke ọma
thankYouMessage: Daalụ ịkpọtụrụ anyị. Otu onye otu anyị ga-aza n'ime ụbọchị ọrụ 3-5.
address: Hope for the Hopeless Initiative, Abuja, Nigeria
emergencyDescription: Maka ihe ndị ngwa ngwa metụtara nzaghachi enyemaka mmadụ na-aga n'ihu, biko kpọọ akara mberede anyị: +234 (0) 987 654 3210
concernDescription: Iji kọwaa omume na-ezighị ezi, nchegbu ụkpụrụ ma ọ bụ mkpesa, biko gaa na peeji mkpesa nzuzo anyị ma ọ bụ zigara ozi-e na ethics@hopeinitiative.org
